::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Tuesday [1860-1877][^1]  
**Manuscript:** MS  Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

My dear [Frances](people/person_1604.qmd),
[Uncle Yonge](people/person_1623.qmd) did not go today. I am sorry to say he has quite got a cold. [Helen](people/person_1613.qmd) is very well and bright – Here is a curiosity by way of a German announcement of a betrothal

Your affect Sister
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The letter must date between the birth of Helen Yonge and the death of the Rev. John Yonge.
